messages:
maria: Heads-up: opening a small PR to clarify the SDK 'batch factory' example and add a migration note for q-profile v2 -> v3. Pinged reviewers.

devon: Link please? I'll take a look after standup.

maria: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1428 — adds compact Python + Go snippets showing KV prefetch + micro-batching, a migration table, and fixes two dead links.

samir: Nice — can we also include a tiny test harness for short-seq perf? Last doc only had long-sequence examples and folks got confused.

maria: Yup. Planning one-file harness at repo/examples/optkit/shortseq_test.py. Snippet:

```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key='REDACTED')
resp = c.generate('summarize', input='short seq', batch_size=8, prefetch=True)
print(resp.text)
```

ezra: lgtm on the example content. CI shows a failure on the docs build though — see ci-bot below.

ci-bot: doc build failed: broken link check (2 dead links). Trace: /optimize/quant-profiles -> 404; /optimize/examples/old-batch -> 404

ruth: I can fix the link replacements; one should point to /optimize/quantization/profiles and the other to /optimize/examples/batch-prefetch.

maria: Thanks Ruth. Also can someone sanity-check the migration wording? Want to avoid implying forced re-quantization — we should say 'recommended re-eval'.

devon: I'll review the wording. Suggest using 'recommended re-evaluation of quant profiles' instead of 'required re-quantization'.

maria: Removing broken links, adding the shortseq test file, and updating wording — pushing a tiny commit in ~10m. @samir can you run a perf smoke locally?

samir: :thumbsup: Will run and report back in ~30m.

deploy-bot: PR #1428 merged to staging by maria — preview: https://docs.redwood.ai/staging/optkit/batch-factory

ezra: Preview looks good. One nit: Go snippet uses old SDK names; should call client.StreamGenerate(ctx, ...) now.

maria: Good catch — updating Go snippet to StreamGenerate.

devon: After that change, I'll approve. Thanks all.
